messages:
Nora: Pinging the group with a new edge-case we noticed in the invite flow: guest invites + SSO enforced orgs + mobile drawer layout. Uploaded a quick Figma frame: https://figma.com/file/guest-invite-v1 Sam: TL;DR: if org has SSO enforced, guest invites should still allow email-only guests (we treat them as external), but UI must not imply we changed org SSO. Kei: Agreed. Suggestion: show a small tertiary line under the email input when guest role selected: "This role allows external (email) access even when SSO is enabled for members." Helps reduce confusion. Vik: A11y/mobile note: the drawer compresses on small screens and that helper line disappears. Need to ensure the helper is visible or accessible via an info icon that opens a short panel. Hannah: Also, we should be careful with language: "SSO enforced" vs "SSO required for members". For guests we should use "SSO not applied to guests" so it's clear. Copy proposal: "Guests: do not require SSO. Members: SSO required by org policy." Nora: Good call. UX ask: where to place the info affordance? Inline under role selector or as a hover/pressable next to the role chip? Mobile needs pressable. Sam: On desktop hovercard is fine; on mobile make it a tabbable info button next to the role name, opens a modal. Keep it within reach of keyboard nav. Kei: Keyboard flow: email -> role selector -> (if guest role chosen) info button -> send. If info button opens modal, trap focus, Esc returns to info button. Make sure role chips are arrow-key navigable. Vik: One more: audit log mapping. If a guest is invited while SSO is enforced for members, audit entry should include roleType=guest and ssoAffected=false so deep-links to Audit Logs can filter correctly. We need to spec query params for that. Hannah: Backend: we can add audit meta: roleKind=guest|member and ssoScope=org|none. Deep link example: /audit?actor=234&action=invite&roleKind=guest&ssoScope=none&start=... We'll document this in the API doc. Nora: UX for "View changes" on success: two options discussed earlier — inline mini-changelog vs deep-link. For this case I prefer inline mini-changelog that surfaces the guest/member distinction, with a "See full audit" link to Audit Logs pre-filtered. Keeps flow consistent on mobile. Sam: Agree. Inline list should show 3-4 items: who invited, roles assigned, SSO status for each role. Each item needs a small copy like: "Jane invited alice@example.com (guest) SSO: not applied" so it's scannable. Kei: Accessibility: the inline changelog must be focusable and announced when shown via aria-live=polite. Also provide a keyboard-only shortcut: when the drawer opens, pressing "/" focuses the email field, pressing "g" toggles the mini-changelog. Add to keyboard help. Vik: Ooh about keyboard shortcut: check collisions with browser native shortcuts. Maybe use Shift+? or `?` open help. Keep it discoverable in a small "Keyboard shortcuts" link. Hannah: Small copy nit: success toast should be "Invites queued recipients will receive emails shortly" and not assert immediate delivery. Also make the toast non-modal and aria-live polite. Provide a stable "Open invite activity" action in the drawer header so keyboard users can reach audit without chasing the toast. DevBot: Pre-merge lint: added rule - ensure all interactive icons have aria-labels. New PR will fail if missing. Sam: Visual/regression: CI flagged focus outline on mobile drawer close button — too thin. Must be 3px on accessible theme. CIbot: Visual regression: guest-invite-v1 failed (drawer close focus thickness, helper line truncation on 360px width). Diff: https://ci.internal/snapshots/2222468100/diff.png Nora: Action items: (1) Sam update Figma: inline helper + mobile info button + copy changes (2) Kei add keyboard shortcuts doc + ARIA snippets for info modal and changelog (3) Vik add audit meta fields and deep-link examples to API doc (4) Hannah update toast behavior and add persistent "Open invite activity" link in header (5) Sam or DesignOps fix focus styles for mobile close. I'll schedule a 15m follow-up tomorrow 9am PT to review diffs. Kei: I'll draft the aria snippet. Example for info button: ```
...
``` Vik: I'll wire up audit param examples in the API doc and include the sample deep-link token pattern. Sam: Updating frames now and will ping when ready for a11y run. Hannah: I'll add the keyboard shortcuts to the Console help panel. Nora: Thanks everyone if nothing else, we'll close this thread after the follow-up.
